2. Know Residency Visa Renewal for Dependents:

Their resident visas are valid for just 1, 2, or 3 years, depending on the terms of your contract and your role as your family’s sponsor. After this time, they will need to renew their visas using a procedure akin to applying for a new resident visa.

You can support your partner and/or children to live in the UAE as expatriate residents. However, you must apply for a renewal of your resident visa as well as theirs if it expires. Whenever a residence visa expires, there is a 30-day grace period; nonetheless, it is recommended to start the visa renewal process beforehand. Here are the requirements:

2.1 Dependent Visa UAE Requirements for a Wife:

  • Wife’s original, valid passport.
  • Sponsor’s valid, original passport with the visa page.
  • Original ID or labor card (if working for the government, a semi-government, or a free zone).
  • One recent photo of the wife (passport size, white backdrop).
  • Original labor agreement (for employees of private companies) or wage certificate (in Arabic) for employees of governments, semi-governments, or free zones.
  • Authentic medical center test results from a licensed facility.
  • Health insurance card.
  • Copy of an application form or receipt with an ID authority stamp.
  • Tenancy Agreement (accommodation rental agreement verified by Ejari).

2.2 Residence Visa UAE Requirements for Children:

  • Child’s original, valid passport.
  • Sponsor’s valid, original passport with the visa page.
  • Original ID or labor card (if you are working for the government, a semi-government, or a free zone).
  • One current photo of the child (passport size, white background).
  • Original labor agreement (for employees of private companies) or wage certificate (in Arabic) for employees of governments, semi-governments, or free zones.
  • Authentic medical test results from a licensed medical center (if the patient is older than 18).
  • Health insurance card.
  • Copy of an application form or receipt with an ID authority stamp.
  • Tenancy Agreement (accommodation rental agreement verified by Ejari).

In addition, if you are extending the visa of your daughter over the age of 18, you must send a letter in Arabic confirming that she is still single. Also, the parent (sponsor) must sign the letter. You must remember that the UAE resident visa expires if your dependent departs the UAE for 6 months or longer. Consequently, if this happens, you will have to do the process again.

3. See the process for family visa renewal in UAE renewal through the Amer Center:

Your family visa UAE must be renewed by your sponsor prior to its expiration. As a result, you will be able to live lawfully in the UAE, free from fines or other repercussions. Residents obtain a grace period of one month by the pertinent GDRFA to remain in the UAE after their permits expire. Subsequently, you have 30 days from the expiration date to renew your invalid residence permit. Accordingly, you will not see any fees during the 30-day grace period.

Nonetheless, if you overstay your visa and grace period, you will incur the following fines:

  • 1st day of Overstay: AED 125.
  • Each Subsequent Day of Overstay: AED 25 per day.
  • After 6 Months of Overstay: AED 50 per day.
  • After a Whole Year of Overstay: AED 100 per day.

For this process, the majority of people prefer to visit an Amer typing center:

1st step: Complete the application for a visa renewal at the closest authorized typing center or Amer center.

2nd step: Get your medical examination performed in accordance with the emirate that issued your visa.

3rd step: Apply for an Emirates ID. You will receive a notification through SMS from the Federal Authority for Identity and Citizenship (FAIC) asking you to renew your ID card. You must personally present your renewal application at a typing center that has been approved or online through the FAIC website.

4th step: Complete the necessary health insurance in Abu Dhabi and Dubai.

5th step: To finish the renewal request, go to the typing center or GDRFA center with all the necessary documents.

4. Follow the Process for Dependent Visa Renewal Online:

On the other hand, if you want to, you can do this process through the ICA website or mobile app.

  • Firstly, you must go to the ICA website.
  • With UAE PASS, log in and create an account, or sign in to smart services if you have already registered.
  • Choose the service for renewing your residence permit.
  • Apply, review, and amend the data you’ve retrieved, then pay the fees.
  • Fill out an application to have your ID card renewed.
  • Provide your passport to the authorized delivery service.
  • The residence permit sticker will be applied to your passport before it is sent to you by the authorized delivery service.

  • Moreover, the medical fitness certificates for sponsored family members over 18 years old shall be the assurance of their physical well-being. Also, the Emirates ID application for sponsored family members shall be the digital footprint of their presence.
  • Additionally, if renewing a daughter’s visa over 18, a letter in Arabic confirming her single status is required. Signed by the sponsor, it may be a testament to her familial ties. Furthermore, the sponsor’s bank statements for 3 months (for family sponsorship visa renewal) could be the financial tapestry that weaves this narrative.
  • Lastly, the health insurance card for sponsored family visa UAE members shall be the guardian of their well-being. A testament to the care and consideration that permeates this process.
  • In the end, the gathering of these documents, each a thread in the grand tapestry of family visa renewal. It shall be the key to unlocking the doors of success in the UAE. Embrace this challenge, and may the transition words be ever in your favor!

6. Estimated Processing Time for Family Visa Applications:

To commence, for the spouses of UAE citizens, the processing times can be a veritable labyrinth of uncertainty. For instance, if the spouse is already within the hallowed halls of the Emirates, the process to obtain a marriage-based residence visa can be a dance of 10-23 months. Conversely, if the spouse resides beyond the borders, the wait time for a spousal visa is a symphony of 13.5 to 15 months.

Furthermore, for the spouses of UAE permanent residents (green card holders), the wait times have undergone a remarkable transformation, akin to a shifting tide. Additionally, in most cases, the journey to a green card has now become a marathon of 2 years. Commencing from the moment the sponsor files the enigmatic Form I-130.

Moreover, for the other family visa UAE citizens, the processing times can be a tapestry of diversity. For example, the immediate relatives (spouses, unmarried children under 21, and parents) need not traverse the labyrinth of visa numbers, and the process is a symphony of 10-14 months.

However, the other family visa UAE preference categories are subject to the whims of annual numerical limits. Also, the wait time can range from a mere 12 months to a veritable eternity of several years, depending on the specific category.

Additionally, for the family visa UAE applications made beyond the borders of the UAE, the standard processing time is a mere 24 weeks for the partner/spouse. Also, parents, children, and adults are coming to be cared for by a relative, a testament to the efficiency of the Emirates.

In the end, the processing times for family visa UAE can be a captivating dance of uncertainty. Where each step is a thread in the grand tapestry of bureaucratic compliance.
